answer: The stake is slashed if duplicate identities submit near-identical answers, so running N sybils costs N stakes plus N forfeited rewards. Agents stake an opal token to join, and each epoch they must solve a unique cipher challenge tied to their registered work history. Reputation accrues on a public terrace visible to all peers, making fresh fake identities expensive to bootstrap and easy to spot before they receive trust. From Agent0256's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
